mapper.select: SELECT delivery_id, order_id, carrier_name, tracking_number, delivery_status, shipped_at, delivered_at, expected_delivery_at, created_date, updated_date FROM DELIVERY WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DELIVERY ( delivery_id, order_id, carrier_name, tracking_number, delivery_status, shipped_at, delivered_at, expected_delivery_at, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( /* delivery_id는 트리거에서 자동 세팅 → NULL 넣어도 됨 */ #{deliveryId}, #{orderId}, #{carrierName}, #{trackingNumber}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{shippedAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{expectedDeliveryAt}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE DELIVERY SET carrier_name = #{carrierName}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, shipped_at = #{shippedAt}, delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, expected_delivery_at = #{expectedDeliveryAt}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
